🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — October 29, 2026

Moon, in Gemini, holds a sextile to Jupiter, in Leo. Two different appetites, forced into one conversation: what you already own finally finds the words to be counted.

Easier — Agreeing on a figure without feeling robbed by it.
Harder — Agreeing to something because agreeing feels pleasant.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus have just closed a sextile, new under everything else.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. Moon sextiles you from Gemini: help that waits to be asked for. Fire that starts things, started cheaply. The hold Saturn had a week ago is not there any more.

♉ TAURUS
Venus rules you from its own Libra. Sun faces you from Scorpio, holding the other figures. Earth that holds on, charged for holding. Since Venus crossed out of Scorpio, the question has changed.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you and passes through Scorpio as a guest. With Moon in your sign, nothing about worth stays abstract. Air shifts until the two options are one. Venus let go of it three weeks ago.

♋ CANCER
Moon governs you, untitled in Gemini. Sun trines you from Scorpio, meeting no resistance. Cardinal water: beginning costs almost nothing. The sextile to Sun that held two weeks ago has let go.

♌ LEO
Sun rules you from Scorpio, untitled. Moon in Gemini opens a gap you have to step into. Fixed fire holds, and holding asks nothing back. Four weeks ago Sun was still in Libra: the ground has moved.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, crosses Scorpio untitled. From Gemini, Moon sets a figure against the wanting. Mutable earth keeps two accounts open and pays both. Retrograde since a week ago, Mercury is still re-reading.

♎ LIBRA
Venus, your ruler, is at home in Libra. From Gemini, Moon agrees with you: the easy angle, also the lazy one. Air begins, and beginning asks little today. The conjunction of a week ago is off it now.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, holds no rank in Leo and simply works. Jupiter squares you from Leo: wanting and cost refuse to agree. Water holds on, and the holding is billed. It arrived inside the last seven days.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter governs you, untitled in Leo. From Gemini, Moon returns your estimate with corrections. Mutable fire: every option kept is an option paid for. Unchanged for three weeks: you know what it asks.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn governs you, unsupported in Aries. Sun sextiles you from Scorpio: a door left ajar. Cardinal earth: the opening move is the cheap one. A week ago Saturn was still held by Mars; that is finished.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. Moon in Gemini sides with you before you have argued. Fixed air keeps what it has, and keeping is easy. This is days old, not weeks, and behaves like it.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, moves through Leo unannounced. From Gemini, Moon cuts across the appetite. Water adapts, and every adaptation has a figure. What pressed two weeks ago has cleared.
